headlines.title: Can AI avoid the boom-and-bust fate of past capital cycles? BofA weighs in
headlines.summary: Investing.com -- Bank of America told clients in a note Friday that the AI investment boom is so far following the classic capital cycle playbook, warning that rising competition and falling prices could push it toward the same disappointing end as past cycles.

headlines.title: BofA’s Hartnett Sees Investors Avoiding Risk on Fed, Midterms
headlines.summary: Risk aversion is set to dominate markets in coming weeks as investors seek shelter from higher interest rates and volatility around US midterm elections and the AI trade, according to Bank of America Corp.’s Michael Hartnett.

headlines.title: Bank of America (BAC) Q3 Results Reveal A Deeper Profit Squeeze
headlines.summary: Bank of America stock barely budged after Q3 2026 earnings, closing at US$51.70, up just 0.6% after a tough few months that left the share price down about 13% over 30 days and roughly 16% over 90 days. The headline story is not the small price move. Instead, it is the pressure running through profitability, with basic earnings per share at US$0.93 and a cost to income ratio at 65.48%, indicating a tighter squeeze on what the bank keeps from every dollar of revenue.

headlines.title: ‘It Is Truly a Cesspool’: Dave Ramsey Targets Bank of America After Its $1.2 Billion Fine
headlines.summary: Dave Ramsey called Bank of America a cesspool and told a Phoenix homeowner to stop paying his loans and dare the bank to come collect. The math behind that advice tells a very different story.

headlines.title: Bank of America sees another interest-rate surprise
headlines.summary: The next Fed decision carries an unexpected complication.

description: Bank of America Corporation, through its subsidiaries, provides various financial products and services for individual consumers, small and middle-market businesses, institutional investors, large corporations, and governments worldwide. It operates through four segments: Consumer Banking, Global Wealth & Investment Management (GWIM), Global Banking, and Global Markets. The Consumer Banking segment offers traditional and money market savings accounts, certificates of deposit and IRAs, checking accounts, and investment accounts and products; credit and debit cards; residential mortgages and home equity loans; and direct and indirect loans. The GWIM segment provides investment management, brokerage, banking, and trust and retirement products and services; wealth management solutions; and customized solutions, including specialty asset management services. The Global Banking segment offers lending products and services, including commercial loans, leases, commitment facilities, trade finance, and commercial real estate and asset-based lending; treasury solutions, and underwriting and advisory services. The Global Markets segment provides market-making, financing, securities clearing, settlement, and custody services; securities and derivative products; and risk management products using interest rate, equity, credit, currency and commodity derivatives, foreign exchange, fixed-income, and mortgage-related products. Bank of America Corporation was founded in 1784 and is based in Charlotte, North Carolina.
